gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with the diagnosis of glioblastoma by the 2021 WHO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: BMS-986504 (other names: MRTX1719): MTA cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: who have progressed on or following previous tumor-directed therapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Total and unbound BMS-986504 concentration will be quantified in Gd-enhancing and Gd-non-enhancing tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor PK and PD analyses will be performed at IVY.
blood, CSF and brain tumor tissue (Gd-enhancing and Gd-non-enhancing tumor tissue will be collected and analyzed separately) will be collected intraoperatively.

role_evidence.quote: Recurrent WHO Grade 4 Glioblastoma MTAP loss/deletion:  (interventions: Drug: BMS-986504)

arms: Recurrent WHO Grade 4 Glioblastoma MTAP loss/deletion

source_quote.quote: Patients with archival tissue demonstrating MTAP loss/deletion confirmed through NGS will be qualified for Phase 0 portion of the study.

coder_notes: Registered phase EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/1): translational subset. PD endpoints are not individually listed but tumour PD analysis in intraoperatively collected tumour tissue is stated. MTAP loss + MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor treated as candidate-matched (manual section 5 example).
